title: Product Form Example
subtitle: Nested details, addresses, and variants
description: A data-heavy catalog editor pattern using the core API (pair with React hooks docs).
content: Large forms should keep leaf inputs on field subscriptions. Arrays use stable row ids.

sections.title: Arrays
sections.content: Use `array('addresses')` for append/remove/move. Prefer React `useFieldArray` in UI. Nested fields: `addresses.0.city`.

sections.title: React wiring
sections.content: See qortex-resource-react: `createResourceHooks((productId) => config)` + section components with `useField('pricing.basePrice')` and `useFieldArray('addresses')`.
